# DEP-NNNN: Title

- Status: Draft
- Owner: Proposal owner
- Created: YYYY-MM-DD

Follow the [DEP process](../docs/design/common.md#dep-process). Replace the prompts below with the proposal; include source anchors for existing contracts.

## Summary

Describe the change and its decision boundary.

## Motivation

Explain the problem and existing behavior.

## Goals

List the intended outcomes.

## Non-Goals

State exclusions and proof limits.

## API

Define resources, fields, validation, conditions, and status ownership.

## Behavior

Describe reconciliation, failure handling, lifecycle, and permissions.

## Compatibility

Explain preserved behavior, migration, and delivery dependencies.

## Documentation

List current-design sections to update on acceptance and user documentation needed for implementation.

## Alternatives

Compare alternatives and explain the decision.

## Tests

Specify required tests and acceptance evidence; distinguish requirements from executed results.
